SELECT ts_recv, first(price) AS open, max(price) AS high, min(price) AS low, last(price) AS close
FROM equs_trades
WHERE symbol = @symbol
  AND ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('m', -10, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
  AND ts_recv <= (SELECT max(ts_recv) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
SAMPLE BY 5s;
SELECT ts_recv, sum(size) AS volume
FROM equs_trades
WHERE symbol = @symbol
  AND ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('m', -10, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
  AND ts_recv <= (SELECT max(ts_recv) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
SAMPLE BY 5s
cells.name: Trades: OHLC (5s) and Volume

SELECT ts_recv, last(bids[1][1]) AS bid, last(asks[1][1]) AS ask
FROM equs_orderbook
WHERE symbol = @symbol
  AND ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('m', -10, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
  AND ts_recv <= @asof
SAMPLE BY 1s;
SELECT ts_recv, avg(spread(bids[1][1], asks[1][1]) / mid(bids[1][1], asks[1][1]) * 10000) AS spread_bps
FROM equs_orderbook
WHERE symbol = @symbol
  AND ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('m', -10, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
  AND ts_recv <= @asof
SAMPLE BY 1s
cells.name: Top of Book: Bid, Ask and Spread (1s)

WITH q AS (
  SELECT symbol, count() AS quote_updates
  FROM equs_orderbook
  WHERE ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('s', -60, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
    AND ts_recv <= @asof
  ORDER BY quote_updates DESC
  LIMIT 10
), l AS (
  SELECT symbol, bids[1][1] AS bid, asks[1][1] AS ask
  FROM equs_orderbook
  WHERE ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('s', -60, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
    AND ts_recv <= @asof
  LATEST ON ts_recv PARTITION BY symbol
), t AS (
  SELECT symbol, count() AS trades, sum(size) AS shares, last(price) AS last_price
  FROM equs_trades
  WHERE ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('s', -60, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
    AND ts_recv <= (SELECT max(ts_recv) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
)
SELECT q.symbol AS Symbol, l.bid AS Bid, l.ask AS Ask,
       cast(round(spread(l.bid, l.ask) / mid(l.bid, l.ask) * 10000, 2) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS Spread_bps,
       q.quote_updates AS Quote_updates, t.trades AS Trades, t.shares AS Shares, t.last_price AS Last_trade
FROM q
LEFT JOIN l ON (q.symbol = l.symbol)
LEFT JOIN t ON (q.symbol = t.symbol)
ORDER BY Quote_updates DESC
cells.name: Most Active Symbols (last 60s)

FROM equs_orderbook
WHERE ts_recv >= (SELECT dateadd('m', -10, max(ts_recv)) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
  AND ts_recv <= @asof
SAMPLE BY 1s;

  AND ts_recv <= (SELECT max(ts_recv) FROM equs_orderbook WHERE ts_recv <= @asof)
